traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י הֵבִ֨ינוּ֙ בַּ דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹדִ֖יעוּ לָ הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι συνῆκαν ἐν τοῖς λόγοις οἷς ἐγνώρισεν αὐτοῖς .
traditions.VUL: quia intelléxerant verba , quæ docúerat eos .
traditions.KJV: because they had understood the words that were declared unto them .

13.english_reference: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe

traditions.WLC: וּ בַ יּ֣וֹם הַ שֵּׁנִ֡י נֶאֶסְפוּ֩ רָאשֵׁ֨י הָ אָב֜וֹת לְ כָל הָ עָ֗ם הַ כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְ הַ לְוִיִּ֔ם אֶל עֶזְרָ֖א הַ סֹּפֵ֑ר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ δευτέρᾳ συνήχθησαν οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν σὺν τῷ παντὶ λαῷ οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται πρὸς Ἔσραν τὸν γραμματέα ,
traditions.VUL: Et in die secúndo congregáti sunt príncipes familiárum univérsi pópuli , sacerdótes et Levítæ , ad Esdram scribam ,
traditions.KJV: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people , the priests , and the Levites , unto Ezra the scribe ,

13.english_reference: even to understand the words of the law

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ הַשְׂכִּ֖יל אֶל דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ תּוֹרָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐπιστῆσαι πρὸς πάντας τοὺς λόγους τοῦ νόμου .
traditions.VUL: ut interpretarétur eis verba legis .
traditions.KJV: even to understand the words of the law .

14.english_reference: And they found written in the law which the LORD had commanded by Moses

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּמְצְא֖וּ כָּת֣וּב בַּ תּוֹרָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּ יַד מֹשֶׁ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εὕροσαν γεγραμμένον ἐν τῷ νόμῳ ᾧ ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τῷ Μωσῇ ,
traditions.VUL: Et invenérunt scriptum in lege præcepísse Dóminum in manu Móysi ,
traditions.KJV: And they found written in the law which the LORD had commanded by Moses ,

14.english_reference: that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר֩ יֵשְׁב֨וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל בַּ סֻּכּ֛וֹת בֶּ חָ֖ג בַּ חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ שְּׁבִיעִֽי
traditions.LXX: ὅπως κατοικήσωσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ ἐν σκηναῖς ἐν ἑορτῇ ἐν μηνὶ τῷ ἑβδόμῳ ,
traditions.VUL: ut hábitent fílii Israel in tabernáculis in die solémni , mense séptimo :
traditions.KJV: that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month :

15.english_reference: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַשְׁמִ֗יעוּ וְ יַעֲבִ֨ירוּ ק֥וֹל בְּ כָל עָרֵי הֶם֮ וּ בִ ירוּשָׁלִַ֣ם

traditions.KJV: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities , and in Jerusalem ,

15.english_reference: saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹר֒ צְא֣וּ הָ הָ֗ר וְ הָבִ֨יאוּ֙ עֲלֵי זַ֨יִת֙ וַ עֲלֵי עֵ֣ץ שֶׁ֔מֶן וַ עֲלֵ֤י הֲדַס֙ וַ עֲלֵ֣י תְמָרִ֔ים וַ עֲלֵ֖י עֵ֣ץ עָבֹ֑ת
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἔσρας Ἐξέλθετε εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ ἐνέγκετε φύλλα ἐλαίας καὶ φύλλα ξύλων κυπαρισσίνων καὶ φύλλα μυρσίνης καὶ φύλλα φοινίκων καὶ φύλλα ξύλου δασέος ,

traditions.KJV: saying , Go forth unto the mount , and fetch olive branches , and pine branches , and myrtle branches , and palm branches , and branches of thick trees ,

15.english_reference: to make booths, as [ it is ] written

traditions.WLC: לַ עֲשֹׂ֥ת סֻכֹּ֖ת כַּ כָּתֽוּב
traditions.LXX: ποιῆσαι σκηνὰς κατὰ τὸ γεγραμμένον .
traditions.VUL: ut fiant tabernácula , sicut scriptum est .
traditions.KJV: to make booths , as [ it is ] written .

16.english_reference: So the people went forth, and brought [ them ], and made themselves booths

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּצְא֣וּ הָ עָם֮ וַ יָּבִיאוּ֒ וַ יַּעֲשׂוּ֩ לָ הֶ֨ם סֻכּ֜וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ λαὸς καὶ ἤνεγκαν , καὶ ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς σκηνὰς
traditions.VUL: Et egréssus est pópulus , et attulérunt . Fecerúntque sibi tabernácula
traditions.KJV: So the people went forth , and brought [ them ] , and made themselves booths ,

16.english_reference: every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim

traditions.WLC: אִ֤ישׁ עַל גַּגּ וֹ֙ וּ בְ חַצְרֹ֣תֵי הֶ֔ם וּ בְ חַצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית הָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ בִ רְחוֹב֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַ מַּ֔יִם וּ בִ רְח֖וֹב שַׁ֥עַר אֶפְרָֽיִם
traditions.LXX: ἀνὴρ ἐπὶ τοῦ δώματος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἕως πύλης Ἐφράιμ .
traditions.VUL: unusquísque in dómate suo , et in átriis suis , et in átriis domus Dei , et in platéa portæ aquárum , et in platéa portæ Ephraim .
traditions.KJV: every one upon the roof of his house , and in their courts , and in the courts of the house of God , and in the street of the water gate , and in the street of the gate of Ephraim .

17.english_reference: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּֽעֲשׂ֣וּ כָֽל הַ֠ קָּהָל הַ שָּׁבִ֨ים מִן הַ שְּׁבִ֥י סֻכּוֹת֮
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησαν πᾶσα ἡ ἐκκλησία οἱ ἐπιστρέψαντες ἀπὸ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας σκηνάς ,

traditions.KJV: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּשְׁב֣וּ בַ סֻּכּוֹת֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκάθισαν ἐν σκηναίς ·
traditions.VUL: et habitavérunt in tabernáculis :
traditions.KJV: and sat under the booths :

17.english_reference: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י לֹֽא עָשׂ֡וּ מִ ימֵי֩ יֵשׁ֨וּעַ בִּן נ֥וּן כֵּן֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַ יּ֣וֹם הַ ה֑וּא
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ ἐποίησαν ἀπὸ ἡμερῶν Ἰησοῦ υἱοῦ Ναυὴ οὕτως οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης ·
traditions.VUL: non enim fécerant a diébus Iósue fílii Nun táliter fílii Israel usque ad diem illum .
traditions.KJV: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so .

17.english_reference: And there was very great gladness .

traditions.WLC: וַ תְּהִ֥י שִׂמְחָ֖ה גְּדוֹלָ֥ה מְאֹֽד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο εὐφροσύνη μεγάλη .
traditions.VUL: Et fuit lætítia magna nimis .
traditions.KJV: And there was very great gladness .

18.english_reference: Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of God

traditions.WLC: וַ֠ יִּקְרָא בְּ סֵ֨פֶר תּוֹרַ֤ת הָ אֱלֹהִים֙ י֣וֹם בְּ י֔וֹם מִן הַ יּוֹם֙ הָֽ רִאשׁ֔וֹן עַ֖ד הַ יּ֣וֹם הָ אַחֲר֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέγνω ἐν βιβλίῳ νόμου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμέραν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας τῆς πρώτης ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας τῆς ἐσχάτης ·
traditions.VUL: Legit autem in libro legis Dei per dies síngulos , a die primo usque ad diem novíssimum .
traditions.KJV: Also day by day , from the first day unto the last day , he read in the book of the law of God .

18.english_reference: And they kept the feast seven days

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּֽעֲשׂוּ חָג֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησαν ἑορτὴν ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ,
traditions.VUL: Et fecérunt solemnitátem septem diébus ,
traditions.KJV: And they kept the feast seven days ;

18.english_reference: and on the eighth day [ was ] a solemn assembly, according unto the manner

traditions.WLC: וּ בַ יּ֧וֹם הַ שְּׁמִינִ֛י עֲצֶ֖רֶת כַּ מִּשְׁפָּֽט
traditions.LXX: καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ ἐξόδιον .
traditions.VUL: et in die octávo colléctam iuxta ritum .
